commit_message:
avformat/mov: perform sanity checks for heif before index building

Fixes: undefined NULL pointer use
Fixes: clusterfuzz-testcase-minimized-audio_decoder_fuzzer-6363211175493632

This performs equivalent sanity checks as are done in mov_read_trak()
before mov_build_index()

Reported-by: Dale Curtis <dalecurtis@chromium.org>
Signed-off-by: Michael Niedermayer <michael@niedermayer.cc>

fix_commit.message: avformat/mov: Check that sample_count is allocated in mov_parse_heif_items()
fix_commit.author: Michael Niedermayer

findings.title: Weakened sample_count/chunk_count check in mov_parse_heif_items() allows sample_count == 0 to slip through, leading to NULL pointer dereference / use of uninitialized index arrays
findings.message: In mov_parse_heif_items(), the previous strict check `if (sc->sample_count != 1 || sc->chunk_count != 1) return AVERROR_INVALIDDATA;` was replaced by a generic sanity_checks() call shared with mov_read_trak(). sanity_checks() only flags an error when `(!sc->sample_size && !sc->sample_count)` is true for a non-zero chunk_count; if a crafted HEIF 'stsz' atom specifies a non-zero fixed sample_size while setting the sample entry count to 0 (or otherwise leaves sc->sample_count at 0 through a code path that also sets sc->sample_size), sanity_checks() returns 0 (success) even though sc->sample_count is 0. mov_parse_heif_items() then proceeds to write `sc->sample_sizes[0]` and to call mov_build_index(mov, st) on a stream context whose sample table is effectively empty/inconsistent, which later leads to a NULL pointer dereference (per the OSS-Fuzz report) when the index-building / demuxing code assumes a valid sample_sizes/sample_count relationship for the stream. The original per-HEIF-item check guaranteed exactly one sample and one chunk before this code ran; the replacement sanity_checks() function does not guarantee sample_count > 0 in all cases, silently weakening this invariant for the HEIF item path.
findings.suggestion: Restore an explicit check that sc->sample_count (and thus the allocated sample_sizes array) is non-zero/consistent for the single-item HEIF case, in addition to the shared sanity_checks(). E.g. change the condition to `if (err || !sc->sample_count) return AVERROR_INVALIDDATA;` as was done in the actual upstream fix.

ground_truth.root_cause: Replacing a specific, correct precondition check (sample_count == 1 && chunk_count == 1) with a more generic, reusable sanity_checks() function that was designed for regular MOV tracks and does not enforce that sample_count is non-zero when sample_size is non-zero, thereby losing an invariant that later code in mov_parse_heif_items() implicitly relies upon.
